marco (infra-oncall): Heads-up — NIC firmware rolling reboot in apac-west2 next Tue 02:00-05:00 UTC. We'll do cohorted node drains + BMC soft reboots, expect transient packet drops during egress handoff.

marco (infra-oncall): Plan: 6 cohorts, ~20m drain each, 5m validation. Canary first 2 nodes then bulk. No model changes.

sara (ml-infra): Which GPU pools are in cohort-3? need to schedule KV cache priming.

marco (infra-oncall): cohort-3 = saturn pools A-D (some dedicated nodes included). I'll paste the drain command.

marco (infra-oncall): ```bash
./drain.sh --cohort cohort-3 --mode graceful --timeout 1200
```

ben (runtime): If we pre-warm fallback capacity in us-east1 we keep p95 latency but ~35% higher cost. Option: model fallbacks/quantized variants.

priya (capacity): Cost: 8 DGX for 3h ≈ $9.5k. Alternative route 12% traffic to quantized in eu-west ≈ saves $7k but quality risk. Need product sign-off.

nina (sre): Can we stagger egress routing per cohort to smooth spikes? Ops-bot can enforce rate limits.

ops-bot: Notice created: incident-prep/apac-west2-nic-fw-9498765432 (pagerduty rotations set).

carlos (support): FYI CS: two big hosted customers in apac-west2 may see retry spikes. I'll prep comms if errors >2xx.

marco (infra-oncall): Canaries: saturn-a-03, saturn-a-07. I'll run health checks at t+10m.

ben (runtime): I'll enable soft-fallback: if p95 >350ms across >2 cohorts trigger cross-region fallback to us-east1 + 3% quality sampling.

sara (ml-infra): KV seed: run `kv-seed --cohort cohort-3 --prefixes=/top-1k-prompts` in post-validate step (~6m).

priya (capacity): Can we shift window +1h to align with APAC midnight? That reduces user impact but raises standby cost. Preference: keep 02:00 UTC.

nina (sre): Keep 02:00 UTC — ops team available and lower global traffic.

marco (infra-oncall): Decision: keep 02:00-05:00 UTC. Action items:
- marco: run canary and post results by 01:50 UTC
- sara: add kv-seed to post-validate for each cohort
- ben: enable soft-fallback and sampling
- priya: provision 4 standby DGX and post final cost delta
- carlos: prepare CS template for high-touch customers
- nina: monitor egress telemetry, escalate if packet-loss >0.5% for >10m

marco (infra-oncall): Do we want a maintenance banner on the prod console for 3h?

carlos (support): Yes. Template: "Planned maintenance in apac-west2 may cause brief increase in request retries. No data loss expected." Keep it minimal.

ben (runtime): Also set `max_concurrency=1` for large-batch endpoints during cohorts to reduce tail latency.

sara (ml-infra): I'll update CI benchmark job and watch eval panels for drift during fallback.

priya (capacity): Standby cost update: 4 DGX for 3h ≈ $4.8k. I'll provision and attach by 01:30 UTC.

nina (sre): LGTM. I'll prepare postmortem template and ensure logs archived.

ops-bot: Runbook uploaded: s3://infra-runbooks/apac-west2-nic-fw-9498765432.md

marco (infra-oncall): Thanks team. Posting final runbook and cohort mapping at 01:20 UTC. Ping me if blockers. :thumbsup:
